parsed.why: Above parent: sanctuary care law, identity-based prison housing, top protective-law band. No local facility or document rule; highest raw incident count lacks per-capita denominator, so hostility is documented but non-universal.

Below parent: first state to repeal gender-identity civil-rights protection, 2026 bar on stronger local ordinances, birth-certificate restroom rule reaching visitors on school grounds, worst legal-risk tier; no local criminalisation of adults.

Tier-1 universal exposure: 2023 statute bars gender-congruent facility use across government buildings, parks, courthouses and airports, with criminal trespass and a documented 2025 arrest; plus Do-Not-Travel label, travel advisories, DL marker-fraud rule.

Worst: state complicity in recent mob violence — victims charged, attackers unarrested, hospital care denied, male-guard search in men's jail despite female marker; no GI hate-crime or discrimination coverage, surgical-proof documents, lowest policy band.

Criminal facility statute reaching government buildings and private businesses statewide (restaurants, hospitals, gas stations), misdemeanour up to a year — harshest universal exposure; mitigated only by pending suit, no enforcement record, retained X on state IDs.
